scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid a recalled space heater being left running unattended during a weekend absence.
Emerging Need: Initial notice only raises a possible safety review; later confirmation, use plans, and a same-day return window turn it into a preventable household risk.
Decision Context: Observable updates identify the affected serial range and pickup deadline, while the saved consumer-case note holds the specific heater serial, order number, and recall inbox needed to judge relevance.
Consequence: Timely attention can keep the unsafe heater out of weekend use; after the apartment is locked and the reachable helper leaves, the intended prevention window has passed.

parameter.subject: Preliminary WarmNest heater safety review
parameter.body: CozyHome has opened a manufacturer safety review for some WarmNest Mini ceramic heaters sold in September. No serial range has been confirmed yet, and owners should wait for the follow-up notice before starting a return or replacement claim. We expect an update by Wednesday morning.

parameter.title: Northwoods weekend away
parameter.description: Away from apartment for cabin weekend. Jules has Friday plant-watering key handoff.

parameter.content: The apartment felt chilly when I stopped by, so I tested your little WarmNest heater in the living room. It works fine. I can leave it near the plant shelf Friday so the room stays warm after I water them.

parameter.subject: WarmNest Mini confirmed recall: serials WN-26B-7000 through WN-26B-7999
parameter.body: WarmNest has confirmed a safety recall for WarmNest Mini ceramic heaters with serial numbers WN-26B-7000 through WN-26B-7999. Affected units should be unplugged and not used unattended. To receive prepaid collection before the weekend, send the serial number and proof-of-purchase order number by Thursday, October 8 at 4:00 PM Central. Later requests will be queued for Monday pickup.

parameter.subject: Last call today for Friday WarmNest recall collection
parameter.body: Reminder: WarmNest Mini recall collection requests received by 4:00 PM Central today can still receive Friday pickup instructions. Requests after the deadline will not receive collection materials until Monday. Please include the heater serial number and original order number so the request can be matched to the affected batch.

parameter.content: I watered the plants, put the WarmNest on low by the shelf, and locked up. I’m heading to the campsite now and probably won’t have cell service until Sunday afternoon.
